recipes.title: Greek Yogurt Cream Cheese (Labneh)

items.i: olive oil, honey and a squeeze of lemon

steps: Stir the salt and lemon juice into the yogurt.
Line a sieve with paper towels or cheesecloth over a bowl, add the yogurt and cover with more paper. For an even thicker result, set something heavy on top.
Refrigerate overnight while the liquid drains out.
Next day it'll be thick like cream cheese. Flavor with chives or spring onion, or top with olive oil, honey and lemon and spread on a bagel.
recipes.notes: Method and amounts from the video narration (the description has no written recipe). Prep time doesn't include straining overnight. Nutrition per 2-tbsp-ish serving is an estimate.
